details: Several prompt rows use ChatGPT without a dated snapshot, so cross-benchmark comparisons may mix different underlying model versions.
GPT-4 benchmark rows likely span multiple GPT-4-era snapshots and should not be treated as one frozen model build.
MentalChat16K scores are judge ratings on a 10-point scale and are not directly comparable to accuracy/F1 benchmarks.
PATIENT-Ψ, MusPsy, and PsychEval are framework or dataset evaluations, not directly comparable frontier model leaderboards.
Rows like Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and Mixtral often represent distinct parameter variants rather than inconsistencies; analyze them as separate models, not one pooled family.
Parameter counts are undisclosed for most proprietary models; leave parameter-size analyses blank or estimated rather than exact.
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index methodology changes over time, so scores from different index versions should not be pooled without a version field.
Exact HealthBench overall scores were textually available for OpenAI models in the paper; for some non-OpenAI models only Consensus results were directly recoverable in text.
